name: SparseEval_benchmark_data
description:
Benchmark Data
	

This directory contains the raw benchmark prediction results in CSV format. These files represent the model outputs and ground truth correctness for various datasets.

	
		
		File Format
	

Each CSV file should contain the following columns:

source: The identifier of the model that generated the prediction.
item: The identifier of the specific test instance (question/sample).
correct: A binary value indicating whether the model's prediction was correct (1) or… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/iridescentttt/SparseEval_benchmark_data.
reputation: A practical collection of raw prediction results used by the SparseEval community for aggregated evaluations; modest niche adoption.
